messages.content:
You are drafting a reply for a human support agent at a clinical practice-management product. The agent will review and edit it before anything is sent. The ticket was escalated to a human for this reason: safety_rule:patient_data_exposure: Patient-data access or exposure always goes to a human. (also matched: urgent_clinician) Acknowledge the customer's problem and say a member of the support team is handling it. Do not promise an outcome or a timeline. Give product steps only if a knowledge-base article is provided and it answers the ticket, and take them only from that article. Put the reply in draft.

Reply with only a JSON object and no other text.
Output: review_draft.
The JSON object must match this JSON schema:
{"additionalProperties": false, "description": "A suggested reply for the human agent who takes an escalation.", "properties": {"draft": {"minLength": 1, "title": "Draft", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["draft"], "title": "review_draft", "type": "object"}

Article: none

Ticket:
URGENT: Possible incorrect patient chart upload and privacy concern

I am writing because I am deeply concerned that a scanned paper lab document may have been attached to the wrong patient chart earlier today. While trying to upload an outside imaging PDF for patient J.S., my screen flickered and the document seemed to drop into the profile of a different patient with similar initials. I tried to remove it immediately by clicking the trash icon next to the attachment, but an error message popped up stating I lacked administrative permissions to delete files from finalized charts. I am very worried about this breach of information and need guidance on how to safely remove it or restrict visibility right away.

value.text:
{
  "draft": "Hello,

Thank you for reaching out and letting us know about the potential misattachment of a patient document. We understand how important this is and want to assure you that a member of our support team is reviewing the situation and will follow up with you shortly.

In the meantime, please refrain from making any further changes to the attachment until we provide further guidance.

Thank you for your patience.

Best regards,
[Support Team]"
}
